configuration.navigation_intent: Continue along the visible drivable road when permissible; obey visible signals and yield as needed. No map or future ego route is supplied.
configuration.vehicle_parameters_source: EXPERIMENT_ASSUMPTIONS, not measured nuScenes vehicle geometry; the same center offset is used in runtime calibration and offline evaluation

recording_boundary: Independent plans from recorded ego states. Later original images are not counterfactual observations following the simulated prefixes. No stitched plan is executed.
context_policy: Each model gets only its own causal two-second capture and optional within-window tool feedback. Full timeline and selection/display poses do not enter capture.
result_policy: Keep every chosen reference and every failure. First two seconds are warm-up, remaining unsampled front frames are observation-only; never call these online planning successes.
selection_basis: Previously exposed acquisition/image-based scene choice; whole ego timeline is selection/display only. No annotation or map read.
automatic_transport_retries_scope: No library HTTP retry or generating POST retry; bounded non-generating readiness GETs are explicit
recovery_scope: Only unprocessed or process-interrupted references; normal completed outcomes including semantic failures are retained. Interrupted charges remain consumed; maximum two charged attempts per original reference across groups.
